verdict.rationale: Docs and a runtime probe confirm Cognee can run fully locally: the open-source engine can be run via Docker or embedded Python calls with no cloud dependency, and a live probe showed `cognee-cli demo` completing an ingest/recall roundtrip with no LLM key and no network calls, plus a local UI via `start_ui()` with no account required. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of configuring specific local/open-weight model backends (e.g., Ollama) for embedding/LLM calls, and independent third-party verification beyond the single runtime probe.
